items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get Chems from the Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in your C.A.M.P. or another player's C.A.M.P., then consume them.

items.title: Collect Mothman Eggs
items.detail: If your C.A.M.P. has a Mothman Nest, harvest the Mothman Eggs it produces directly from the nest.

items.title: Complete the Event: "The Mothman Equinox"
items.detail: Fast travel to Point Pleasant and complete the event: destroy vines, kill cultists, destroy totems, place blood, light pyres, and defend them.

items.title: Kill Cultists during The Mothman Equinox event
items.detail: Concentrate on defending the Church Pyre through event waves and use area-of-effect weapons to tag enemies.

items.title: Kill a Cryptid with a Bow or Crossbow
items.detail: Fast travel to Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go and walk straight ahead where Snallygasters spawn; equip a bow or crossbow before the kill.

items.title: Sell Mothman Egg Omelette to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Craft Mothman Egg Omelette (one Mothman Egg + one Wood) at a cooking station and sell to any NPC vendor.

items.title: Sell Ribeye Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Kill a Brahmin, cook Ribeye Steak (one Brahmin Meat + one Wood), and sell to any NPC vendor.

items.title: Collect Energy Ammo
items.detail: Take energy ammo from your stash, craft it at a Tinker's Workbench, or loot it from enemies killed with energy weapons.

items.title: Collect a Board Game
items.detail: If your C.A.M.P. has a Games Cupboard, take a Board Game from it to receive Blast Radius, Autopsy, Catch the Commie, Rad Poker or Unstoppables! games.

items.title: Destroy Robots with an Energy Weapon
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center and destroy robots using energy weapons like Laser Rifles, Plasma Guns, or Tesla Rifles.

items.title: Destroy a Robot
items.detail: Fast travel to RobCo Research Center for dependable robot spawns and destroy any robots encountered.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from wild plants or fungi in the world, or plant vegetables in your C.A.M.P. and harvest them.

items.title: Kill The Reborn Pint-Sized Slasher
items.detail: Start a Head Hunt at Highway Town Bounty Board by hanging a wanted poster (5,000 caps or from Grunt Hunts) and complete it to trigger the Slasher appearance.

items.title: Sell Pumpkin Pie to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Buy Pumpkin Pie from Mr Waiter or Ms Waitress at The Whitespring Resort or find one at Pumpkin House, then sell to an NPC vendor.

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any weapon to an NPC vendor; The Whitespring Resort has multiple vendors or craft inexpensive grenades to sell.

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to another player's C.A.M.P. and enter their Shelter by finding camps with a shelter icon on the map.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week by finishing any six daily challenges each day.

events.description: Seasonal event featuring holiday-themed Scorched enemies with special rewards.

events.name: Meat Week
events.description: Event centered around cooking and Brahmin with Graham's Meat Cook activities.

events.name: Minerva's Big Sale (List 8)
events.description: Special vendor sale featuring discounted plans and equipment.

events.name: The Mothman Equinox
events.description: Public event at Point Pleasant featuring cultists, rituals, and Mothman-themed challenges.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Event offering increased rewards and mutated Daily Ops with new seasonal loot.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events with mutation modifiers offering special rewards from Mutated Packages.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Weekend event providing double experience points for faster character progression.

events.name: World Pets Update
events.description: Major update introducing world pets and launching Season 27.
